mapper.select: SELECT uc.id AS user_coupon_id, uc.coupon_id, c.coupon_name, c.type, c.threshold_amount, c.discount_amount, uc.expire_time FROM user_coupon uc INNER JOIN coupon c ON c.id = uc.coupon_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.coupon_status = 0 AND uc.expire_time > NOW()

SELECT uc.id AS user_coupon_id, uc.user_id, u.username, uc.coupon_status, uc.receive_time, uc.use_time, uc.order_no FROM user_coupon uc INNER JOIN user u ON u.id = uc.user_id WHERE uc.coupon_id = #{couponId} ORDER BY uc.receive_time DESC
